assumptions.eps_liquid: Drude from liquid Al's DC resistivity (Desai 1984) and density (Assael 2006), scaled to the level named; Edison r8-coaxial-radiometry: 0.10-0.15 at 1 um for clean liquid Al, 0.15-0.25 effective in LPBF
assumptions.train: slide and window (3.5 %/surface off their 1064 V-coat), f-theta (Thorlabs FTH100-1064 curve), two galvo mirrors (pass: 0.90; Kozjek/Hooper: 0.02 at 750-875 nm), DMSP1000 (Thorlabs data)
